name: Evanescence

whyMatters.en: Little Rock act formed in the mid-1990s. Fallen (2003) combined goth-piano hooks with nu-metal guitars; Bring Me to Life dominated early-2000s rock radio.
whyMatters.zh: 小石城乐队，1990 年代中期成立。Fallen（2003）结合哥特钢琴钩子与 nu-metal 吉他；Bring Me to Life 占领 2000 年代初摇滚电台。

lyricQuotes: Wake me up inside / Call my name and save me from the dark
I'm so tired of being here / Suppressed by all my childish fears

shortBio.en: Amy Lee–fronted goth/nu-metal crossover; Bring Me to Life is the 2003 chart peak.
shortBio.zh: Amy Lee 领衔哥特/nu-metal 跨界；Bring Me to Life 是 2003 榜单峰值。

body.en:
Formed in the mid-1990s in Little Rock, Arkansas. Fallen (2003) is the commercial record: Ben Moody–era guitars, string/choir arrangements, Lee’s mezzo lead and piano hooks.

Bring Me to Life (2003), with Paul McCoy’s guest vocal, put the band on nu-metal rock radio. The catalog shows how early-2000s rock radio absorbed goth-pop melody while keeping heavy playlist placement.
body.zh:
1990 年代中期于阿肯色小石城组建。Fallen（2003）是主要商业唱片：Ben Moody 时期吉他、弦乐/合唱编曲、Lee 女中音主唱与钢琴钩子。

与 Paul McCoy 客串的 Bring Me to Life（2003）把乐队送上 nu-metal 摇滚电台。目录显示 2000 年代初摇滚电台如何在保持重型列表位置的同时吸收哥特流行旋律。

note.zh: 钢琴 intro 接降调 riff；录音室 Paul McCoy 客串 rap；Lee 女中音主唱。

note.zh: 谣曲钢琴与弦乐编曲；哥特流行旋律进摇滚播放列表。

note.zh: 切分失真吉他与 Lee belting；Fallen 时期现场组曲锚点。

title.zh: 哥特钢琴上 nu-metal 电台

body.en:
Fallen (2003) merges Amy Lee’s classical-piano goth hooks with down-tuned guitar and arena production.

Bring Me to Life’s piano-to-riff switch and guest rap verse fit rock-radio crossover formatting.

My Immortal places ballad strings on the same album as chugging distortion.

Fallen sold multi-platinum.
body.zh:
Fallen（2003）把 Amy Lee 的古典钢琴哥特钩子与降调吉他和体育场制作合并。

Bring Me to Life 的钢琴接 riff 切换与客串 rap 主歌适合摇滚电台跨界格式。

My Immortal 把谣曲弦乐与切分失真放在同一张专辑。

Fallen 多白金销量。

alt.en: Amy Lee of Evanescence at Laredo Energy Arena
alt.zh: Evanescence 的 Amy Lee，Laredo Energy Arena

body.en:
1995–2003: Lee and Moody as writers; Gray, LeCompt, and Boyd as the live band for the Fallen cycle.

Moody left in October 2003; Lee became the sole creative anchor through later lineup changes.

The Open Door (2006) continues piano/goth metal with new guitar personnel.

Lee’s vocal range and piano intros remain constant across roster changes.
body.zh:
1995–2003：Lee 与 Moody 写作；Gray、LeCompt、Boyd 为 Fallen 周期现场班底。

Moody 于 2003 年 10 月离队；Lee 成为唯一创作锚点，经后续阵容变动。

The Open Door（2006）以新吉他人员延续钢琴/哥特金属。

Lee 音域与钢琴 intro 经阵容变动保持不变。

title.zh: 2000 年代摇滚电台哥特跨界

body.en:
Evanescence put female-fronted goth-rock on US rock radio alongside nu-metal peers.

The Cure’s melodic gloom and Nirvana’s dynamic shifts are audible ancestors; execution is more cinematic and string-heavy.

Bring Me to Life and My Immortal remain licensing and cover-song staples.

Later symphonic rock records extend the catalog; Fallen is the main citation.
body.zh:
Evanescence 把女主唱哥特摇滚送上美国摇滚电台，与 nu-metal 同辈并行。

The Cure 的旋律暗色与 Nirvana 的动态切换是可闻祖先；执行更电影化、弦乐更重。

Bring Me to Life 与 My Immortal 仍是授权与翻唱常备。

后期交响摇滚延伸目录；Fallen 是主要引用。
